name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, where he excelled in mechanical engineering. He began his career in Formula Nippon, quickly rising through the ranks to become a lead engineer for a midfield team. His meticulous approach to data analysis and his knack for identifying subtle performance gains caught the attention of ALL-INKL.COM Münnich Motorsport, who headhunted him to lead their engineering efforts.

Kenji is a firm believer in the power of incremental improvements. He emphasizes thorough testing and data-driven decision-making, always striving to optimize every aspect of the car's performance. While he may not be the most charismatic leader, his unwavering dedication and sharp technical mind make him an invaluable asset to the team. He is known for his calm demeanor even under pressure, a trait that helps him guide his team through challenging situations.

What sets Kenji apart is his innovative approach to problem-solving, often finding unconventional solutions that others overlook. He possesses a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and a relentless pursuit of perfection.
